reads.author: swyx .ai
reads.description: We have Fable at home... or so we are being told by paid shills
reads.summary: 2 months ago we covered Z.ai CEO Prof Jie Tang’s prediction that we’d get a Fable-class open weights model by year end . As a result, K3.1 Pro achieves consistent gains in every domain.

reads.title: AI Is Getting Good at Math. Here’s Why.
reads.author: Ankit Maloo
reads.description: AI models are solving more mathematical problems. A pattern is emerging in their successes that could help us predict which problems they’ll solve next.
reads.summary: In May, an internal model at OpenAI found a counterexample to Erdős's unit distance conjecture . A month later, OpenAI published a proof of the Cycle Double Cover (CDC) problem , then solutions to ten more open problems by July.

A new totals_by_client array is available in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.

reads.title: 2026.43: A New Era

reads.summary: Welcome back to This Week in Stratechery! This week marks a new era for Stratechery, which is now presented by Stripe .

reads.title: Python's F-String for String Interpolation and Formatting
reads.description: Python f-strings give you a readable, concise way to interpolate and format strings, and they beat .format() and the % operator on speed.
reads.summary: Python f-strings offer a concise and efficient way to interpolate variables, objects , and expressions directly into strings. By prefixing a string with f or F , you can embed expressions within curly braces ( {} ), which are evaluated at runtime .

reads.title: Get Started With Django: Build a Portfolio App
reads.description: Build a Django example project step by step. You'll create a portfolio app and learn about models, views, templates, and the admin.
reads.summary: Django is a powerful Python web framework for creating complex applications. It follows the Model-View-Template (MVT) architecture and includes built-in features like authentication, an admin interface, and database management.
